text: Are you good at telling a joke?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Yeah, I'm really, really good at this. I consider myself a very humorous person — I can always make my friends laugh out loud. And I think jokes are a great thing. If a person doesn't have any jokes in their life, I think their life is totally a mess — a boring mess, boring as hell.
